title: Ukax Retiro Solitario satawa
intro: Diosan favorapat anales ukanakanjja, jan uñtasit qʼoma almaw utji, jupajj markapatwa yaqhachatäpjje, ukhamat qollan thakin sapakïñ thaqhañataki. Uka saparst’atäñax taqi pachatakiw mä chimpu apanini, iyawsäwin yant’äwipa, wiñayatakiw parlasini, ukxa janiw yatipkänti.
clues: Mä jachʼa profetan uñjataw nayarojj uchatäyäta.
Allah ukan manq’añanakapampiw yanapt’asiyäta, ukax guardiajaruw muspharayitu.
Familiajatjja, inti jalsu toqenkir mä cheqaruw sarjjayäta.
Mä angelaw mä jan juchani jaqir uñtat uñstawayitu, mä qʼuma yuqall wawat yatiyañataki.
Jichhak wawajampi kuttʼanjjayäta ukhajja, markajajj juchañchapjjetäna, ukampis uka wawajj nayar arjjatañatakiw arsüna.

outcome.answer: Mä jiskʼa wawaw mä taykar arjjatañatak arsüna

arabic: وَٱذْكُرْ فِى ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ مَرْيَمَ إِذِ ٱنتَبَذَتْ مِنْ أَهْلِهَا مَكَانًۭا شَرْقِيًّۭا
verse: And mention, [O Muḥammad], in the Book [the story of] Mary, when she withdrew from her family to a place toward the east. (19:16)
